verdict.rationale: LegalZoom has a dedicated annual-report service page offering real-time compliance-status notifications. Its registered agent offering adds annual-report deadline reminders through the Compliance Calendar, which supports filing on time. However, none of the excerpts explicitly say LegalZoom files the annual report for you, and franchise tax is not mentioned at all. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that LegalZoom prepares and submits annual reports, any franchise tax filing capability, independent or hands-on corroboration of on-time filing.
